an7.20:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca sikkhāsamādāne avigatapemo,
an7.20:1.4: dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca dhammanisantiyā avigatapemo,
an7.20:1.5: icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca icchāvinaye avigatapemo,
an7.20:1.6: paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca paṭisallāne avigatapemo,
an7.20:1.7: viriyārambhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca viriyārambhe avigatapemo,
an7.20:1.8: satinepakke tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca satinepakke avigatapemo,
an7.20:1.9: diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo.
an7.20:1.10: Imāni kho bhikkhave satta niddasavatthūnī ti. Tass' udānaṃ:
